text:
maya: Quick readout from the unit-econ scorer on the new polaris-lite-9p bring-up (5k sampled chat requests). TL;DR + proposal below — tagging @arjun @dom @selene for product/GTN input.

arjun: great, numbers?

maya: paste metrics (short):
```
Model: polaris-lite-9p-int6
p50 latency: 180ms
p95 latency: 420ms
avg tokens/req: 450
cost per 1M tokens: $18.40
GTN eval score (multi-turn): 0.86

Model: polaris-lite-9p-int4
p50 latency: 220ms
p95 latency: 680ms
avg tokens/req: 450
cost per 1M tokens: $10.20
GTN eval score (multi-turn): 0.81
```

dom: that looks like ~44% cost save for int4 with ~0.05 absolute quality drop — where does the quality hit come from?

maya: most regressed slices are long multi-turn threads (context > 800 tokens) and edge-case instruction-following (few-shot style prompts). single-turn summarization and short Q&A are ~parity. hallucination rate unchanged within noise.

selene: can you put a recommendation for product? enterprise vs free users?

maya: recommendation (short):
- Mixed-fleet routing: default -> int4; route to int6 when context_tokens > 800 OR user_tier == "enterprise" OR request flagged by GTN as high-criticality.
- Canary rollout: start w/ 5% traffic (gradually increase to 30% over 2w).
- Monitoring: add slice-level smoke checks for long-context recall and instruction fidelity; fail-open to int6 if regression > 0.03 on GTN eval.

arjun: do you have expected unit-econ after routing?

maya: quick calc (est):
- Baseline (all int6): $18.40 / 1M toks
- All int4: $10.20 / 1M toks
- Mixed 70% int4 + 30% int6 -> cost = 0.7*10.2 + 0.3*18.4 = ~$12.96 / 1M toks (~30% cost reduction vs all-int6)
- With routing (assume 20% long-contexts -> pinned to int6) -> approx $14.08 / 1M toks (~24% savings)

dom: sounds reasonable. risk: hidden regressions on rare slices. what's gating plan?

maya: gating:
- GTN eval integration: run nightly diff on the canary traffic against control (control = prod model). Alert on: GTN score delta <= -0.02 OR increase in failure/hallucination metrics.
- Shadow shadow-runs for 48h on top-5 product flows.
- Holdback plan: feature flag to immediately flip traffic to int6.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary flag registered: `polaris-lite-9p-mixed-fleet-canary` -> default 0.05. Ops runbook: /run rollout-canary polaris-lite-9p 5% -> 30% over 14d.

selene: for GTM summary I need 1 sentence for the deck.

maya: GTM line: "Polaris-lite-9p int4 offers ~44% lower per-token cost with a modest 0.05 GTN-score drop; recommended mixed-fleet routing to capture ~24–30% cost savings while preserving long-context fidelity for enterprise traffic."

arjun: +1. add a note for docs: update model page with performance/quality tradeoffs and the routing rule examples.

dom: can we add an eval slice for "instruction-following few-shot" as a must-pass before 30% traffic?

maya: yes — I'll add that to the nightly GTN suite and mark it as a gating slice.

selene: OK, I'll brief GTN/product this afternoon and ask ops to schedule the canary.

maya: followups: I'll drop the per-slice CSV + summary to the onboarding doc by EOD. ping me if you want the raw samples. :thumbsup:

arjun: thanks, useful. :thumbsup:
